decisions.reason: The DPA management tool costs little to maintain as software, fits the firm's stated compliance direction, and has early positive feedback from agencies, so keeping the option open is worthwhile while its value is still uncertain.
The management platform is the flagship featured on the home page and central to the agency-focused strategy, so the firm is committing further to it rather than abandoning it.
The configurable managed hosting plan builds on the firm's core infrastructure at low incremental cost, and its prospects are still unresolved, so dropping it would give up the option prematurely.
